originalTitle: Two sublinear suppliers suffice for central discrepancy
originalHypotheses: Banked canonical counting coupling, injectivity and reach bounds.
Nonnegative nondecreasing sublinear record-drop envelope h.
Uniform Pell-window norms b_j=o(q_j). Both game suppliers remain open.
independence: Proof reconstructed from primary arguments and explicit definitions. Earlier source status/review assertions were not treated as proof. The author previously collected these sources; the present derivations and finite/exact-algebra checks are new independent audit work.
detailedDerivation: From a nonnegative nondecreasing record-drop envelope h, earlier inversions lie in(d(n),M_n], giving B_n≤h(n). Any later owner contributing d(r)<d(n) has r<d(r)<d(n)≤2n+1 and d(r)≥d(n)−h(2n+1); injectivity gives F_n≤h(2n+1). Hence |η_n|≤h(2n+1)=o(n).

Uniform Pell-window bound b_j=o(q_j) gives density by elementary tiling, avoiding an external Ostrowski theorem: fix j, tile[0,N] into q_j intervals, and bound |A(N)−βN|/N≤(b_j+|p_j−βq_j|)/q_j+O(q_j/N). First letN→∞, thenj→∞, using p_j/q_j→β.
Rank counting gives η=d(n)−A(d(n))−n−1. Expanding J(n)−(2+√2)J(d(n))−√2(1+η) and using(2+√2)(√2−1)=√2 proves I3 directly.
Since n<d(n)≤2n+1, J(d(n))=o(n). All three I3 terms are o(n), so D_cen=o(n). No game supplier is proved.
The source’s additional subcritical recurrence corollary has its displayed endpoint rate already corrected: at coefficienta=0 with additiveC>0 the rate is O(j), not O(1). Both rates remain o(q_j).
